name: canli-quant-mcp
description: 235 quant finance tools and a library of 399 strategy sleeves as one MCP server: performance and risk, options and exotics, fixed income, portfolio construction, econometrics (regime switching, Johansen, CUSUM, HAR), indicators, execution, crypto and FX, valuation, backtests with multiple-testing corrections (deflated Sharpe, SPA, StepM, PBO), data annotation and ML labels (triple barrier, purged CV) and data checks, each checked against QuantLib, statsmodels, arch, TA-Lib or numpy. Keyless and local with no network, disk writes or logging; three tools in context by default.
